lines.text: Did you know? Rupt is Latin for break.
Quick quiz! Which means between plus break?

words.ex: The strike disrupted rail services across the country.

publish.title: Rupt root: disrupt, eruption and interruption
publish.value: Rupt comes from Latin "rumpere" (to break). Words: disrupt, eruption and interruption. disrupt = dis + rupt; eruption = e + rupt; interruption = inter + rupt.
